sources.title: How do I log out of all active sessions?
sources.summary_zh: Web Settings > Account > Log Out immediately signs out web, mobile, and desktop sessions. The web session is 28 days and refreshes to 28 days after page activity. Claude Code authorization tokens are separately managed at Settings > Claude Code; deleting a token logs out that Claude Code authorization.

supported_claims.locator: Help page, updated 2026-08-06; sections “How long are sessions on the Claude web app?”, “How to log out of all active sessions”, “How to log out from Claude Code”.

Claude Code setup also links location eligibility to Anthropic supported countries. Recheck at move time because this list can change.

sources.title: Safeguards warnings and appeals
sources.summary_zh: The official appeal route is to sign in at claude.ai with the suspended account and submit the linked appeal form; the form requires login. Anthropic names repeated Usage Policy violations, account creation from an unsupported location, and Terms violations as possible suspension reasons. Banned Free/Pro/Max users may still export available data or delete their account from the restricted screen; export availability may be limited. Organization-on-hold review is a separate path.

supported_claims.locator: Updated 2026-07-09; Appeals and “Export your data or delete your account”.
supported_claims.claim: The official appeal route is to sign in at claude.ai with the suspended account and submit the linked appeal form; the form requires login. Anthropic names repeated Usage Policy violations, account creation from an unsupported location, and Terms violations as possible suspension reasons. Banned Free/Pro/Max users may still export available data or delete their account from the restricted screen; export availability may be limited. Organization-on-hold review is a separate path.

sources.limits: It does not promise a review timeline, reversal, or full data export. Do not create substitute accounts or attempt to bypass a suspension; follow the official review path.

sources.title: Anthropic’s Transparency Hub: System Trust and Reporting
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic reports 11.4 million banned accounts, 398,000 appeals, and 42,000 appeal overturns for Jan–Jun 2026. Thus the historical Chat’s 11.4m figure is independently confirmed as an official aggregate. These counts are not a user-level probability, do not specify that all bans are permanent or unique people, and do not establish why any individual account was actioned.

sources.title: Set up Claude Code
sources.summary_zh: Claude Code requires internet access and location in an Anthropic-supported country. Supported authentication choices include Claude.ai with Pro/Max, Anthropic Console, and enterprise cloud providers. Anthropic says Claude Code securely stores credentials and directs readers to Credential Management. For a normal device move, reinstall from the official source, authenticate through the intended account/provider, and check the credential-management steps for the currently installed version.

supported_claims.locator: System requirements and authentication sections; current docs page observed 2026-09-30.
supported_claims.claim: Claude Code requires internet access and location in an Anthropic-supported country. Supported authentication choices include Claude.ai with Pro/Max, Anthropic Console, and enterprise cloud providers. Anthropic says Claude Code securely stores credentials and directs readers to Credential Management. For a normal device move, reinstall from the official source, authenticate through the intended account/provider, and check the credential-management steps for the currently installed version.

sources.limits: This page does not provide a per-device remote revoke procedure; Claude account token revocation is documented separately. Installation commands and supported OS versions may change.

sources.title: Enterprise network configuration
sources.summary_zh: Claude Code supports standard HTTP/HTTPS corporate proxies and documents required Anthropic/Claude hosts to permit through approved proxy/firewall rules. The page also describes organization IP allowlisting: where an organization has enabled it, proxy egress must match the organization allowlist and dedicated egress is advised; shared vendor egress may admit other customers. This is a legitimate enterprise network configuration, not evidence that VPN/proxy use changes supported-region eligibility.

sources.title: Countering misuse of AI: September 2026
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic describes proxy networks/transfer stations as part of illicit, industrial-scale access campaigns using fake accounts, stolen identities/payment methods, or stolen API keys to circumvent geographic and related controls; some third-party routers also retained and resold user transcripts. It also reports account-level metadata/content as campaign attribution signals. This concerns adversarial bulk abuse and user-data exposure through untrusted intermediaries. It does not establish that ordinary device migration, a changed home/work IP, or a legitimate corporate proxy triggers enforcement.

sources.title: What to do before you sell, give away or trade in your iPhone or iPad
sources.summary_zh: Apple’s handover path is backup, transfer, sign out, erase all content/settings, and remove the old device from trusted devices. If the phone number changes, add trusted numbers before transfer to avoid loss of account access. Erase removes local data and disables Find My/Activation Lock while leaving iCloud content intact.

supported_claims.locator: Sections “If you still have your old iPhone or iPad” and “Remove your personal information”; transfer/backup, sign-out, erase, trusted-device removal.
supported_claims.claim: Apple’s handover path is backup, transfer, sign out, erase all content/settings, and remove the old device from trusted devices. If the phone number changes, add trusted numbers before transfer to avoid loss of account access. Erase removes local data and disables Find My/Activation Lock while leaving iCloud content intact.

sources.limits: Apple device-specific steps and menu labels depend on OS version. This is for transfer/disposal; migration to a retained device does not require erasing it.

sources.title: What to do before you sell, give away, trade in, or recycle your Mac
sources.summary_zh: Apple recommends a backup/file transfer, account/service sign-out, and factory reset before the Mac leaves the owner. Supported Macs should use Erase All Content and Settings; other Macs use the documented Recovery erase/reinstall process. Leave the device at setup assistant for the new owner.

supported_claims.locator: “Use Erase All Content and Settings” for Apple silicon/T2 on macOS Monterey+; older Mac steps include deauthorize, sign out of iCloud and Messages, erase/reinstall macOS, stop at Setup Assistant.
supported_claims.claim: Apple recommends a backup/file transfer, account/service sign-out, and factory reset before the Mac leaves the owner. Supported Macs should use Erase All Content and Settings; other Macs use the documented Recovery erase/reinstall process. Leave the device at setup assistant for the new owner.

sources.limits: Applies when handing off or disposing of a Mac. For migration where the old Mac remains yours, it can remain in your Apple Account and need not be erased.

sources.title: Review devices signed in to your Apple Account
sources.summary_zh: The Apple Account device list shows associated/trusted devices and allows remote removal/sign-out. Removed devices lose access to iCloud, Find My, other Apple services, and 2FA codes. A device still signed in may reappear, so Apple says to sign out on it or erase it for permanent removal.

supported_claims.locator: “What devices on your Apple Account can do”, “When to remove a device”, removal steps, and “If your Apple device is lost or you no longer want to use it”.

sources.limits: Account device removal manages Apple Account associations; it is not a substitute for organization MDM offboarding or clearing device storage.

sources.title: Revoke user access in an emergency in Microsoft Entra ID
sources.summary_zh: Admins can block new sign-ins and revoke refresh tokens/sessions in Entra. Microsoft cautions that app-issued session cookies may persist until the app rechecks Entra or the app itself revokes them; access-token effects can wait for expiry. Use the organization’s offboarding workflow and independently deprovision apps that do not federate their session control.

supported_claims.locator: Sections “Session tokens (cookies)”, “Microsoft Entra environment”, and “When access is revoked”.
supported_claims.claim: Admins can block new sign-ins and revoke refresh tokens/sessions in Entra. Microsoft cautions that app-issued session cookies may persist until the app rechecks Entra or the app itself revokes them; access-token effects can wait for expiry. Use the organization’s offboarding workflow and independently deprovision apps that do not federate their session control.

sources.limits: Administrative guidance for work/school identity; requires appropriate roles. Revocation is not always instantaneous across every app/device.

sources.title: Device action: Retire — Microsoft Intune
sources.summary_zh: Intune Retire removes managed company data/configuration and unenrolls without a full factory reset, preserving personal content; wipe resets the device. Actions wait until device check-in. On iOS, managed profiles/certs/network settings are removed; on Windows/macOS details vary, and some Entra records remain. Back up BitLocker recovery key and local admin credentials before retiring Entra-joined Windows devices.

supported_claims.locator: Retire overview and platform data tables, including iOS/macOS/Windows notes.
supported_claims.claim: Intune Retire removes managed company data/configuration and unenrolls without a full factory reset, preserving personal content; wipe resets the device. Actions wait until device check-in. On iOS, managed profiles/certs/network settings are removed; on Windows/macOS details vary, and some Entra records remain. Back up BitLocker recovery key and local admin credentials before retiring Entra-joined Windows devices.

sources.limits: Results differ by platform and management configuration. Do not assume Retire is a full device erase or that a pending action has completed. A manager/admin should select the operation consistent with ownership and redeployment.
